decision: Training exactness is far below the preregistered 95% adequacy floor and the 22.60-point train-to-development action gap exceeds the 10-point generalization threshold. V75 has both residual fit capacity and a dominant held-out conditional-generalization failure. Output-only teacher-native sequence training is closed.
next_authorized_work: One no-training feasibility and accounting study may test importing fixed-projection teacher input/output lexical substrate into the exact v4 action space while retaining zero source blocks and explicit imported-parameter accounting.
